name: Kayama Suzune
source:
Suzune is honest, gentle, and kind, but a little absent-minded. She went to an all-girls school, so she hasn't had much interaction with men, and has very little knowledge about sex.

After losing her parents in a sudden accident and being left with no relatives, she is taken in by the chief of the village where she lived as a child.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.girls-software.com/doas/#character]official website[/url]]
